global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with vibrant green scallions, it sits in a white bowl with chopsticks resting nearby, under warm, ambient lighting on a wooden table.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with subtle glossy finish, featuring black Japanese characters and red seal mark near rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and bean sprouts, appears rich, golden-brown, and slightly oily.
regions.chopsticks: Light wooden chopsticks, smooth surface, tapered ends, natural grain visible, resting diagonally.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has a glistening, caramelized surface with visible fat marbling and a slightly uneven, irregular shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved pieces with visible fibrous texture and faint greenish hue.
